title.narrative: EU Technical Assistance Facility for improving sustainable forest management (Forests For the Future Facility - F4)

description.narrative: The purpose of this contract is to establish and manage the Forest For the Future Facility (F4) which will provide technical support to the Commission services (both Commission Headquarters and EU Delegations) and partner countries to ensure sustainable forest management, reduce deforestation/forest degradation, promote sustainable investments and decent jobs in partner countries.
